provenance.method: Bounded review of current NHS insomnia information; listing is a clinical navigation route, not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.

name: NHS insomnia information
description: NHS information about insomnia, possible contributing factors, self-care context and when to seek medical help.
intended_use: A clinical handoff when sleep difficulty is persistent, severe or affecting daytime functioning.
audience_or_context: People with ongoing sleep difficulty who need NHS information or a route to clinical assessment.
limitations: The page does not make ND Oracle capable of diagnosing insomnia or another sleep disorder.
ND Oracle does not recommend prescription medicines, melatonin, supplements, doses or medication changes.
cost_or_access_notes: Free public NHS information; access to local clinical services varies.
